strengths.mechanism: Character readme and replaceable default scenario accompany distinct new/resume actions.
strengths.benefitInference: Users can understand the premise and choose a fresh story deliberately.

strengths.mechanism: Searchable conversation history includes summary cards and creator-enabled Explore.
strengths.benefitInference: Users can select the intended story and investigate its remembered state.

strengths.mechanism: Editable lore and experimental private memories retain superseded entries; recall has a token budget.
strengths.benefitInference: Creators can correct continuity errors and control recalled material.

strengths.mechanism: Chat Inspector and Diagnostics expose resolved contexts, prompts, raw results and generation parameters.
strengths.benefitInference: Unexpected behavior becomes easier to trace to prompt construction or provider output.

strengths.mechanism: Saved configurations and individual service tests.

tradeoffs.note: Editing, deletion and regeneration are exposed in Chat view, not simpler views. Discovery cost is a reviewer concern, not an observed usability failure.
Automatic memories and understanding are explicitly experimental and require a memory service.
No configuration switch during chat. Precedence: forced scenario, forced character, selected configuration.
Full Windows desktop, Linux server and Android editions require a subscription; Lite is cloud-only. Software is proprietary.

Assets require .voxpak. Backups need database and Users/ together. Windows device.key is machine-bound; Device-mode encrypted content needs preparation before moving. Cloud Storage does not carry chats, settings or keys.

unknowns.note: Conversation forks/checkpoints, alternate-reply preservation and edit-triggered state rollback were not established. Scripted story branching is not evidence of conversation forking.
No response-quality, memory-accuracy, latency, accessibility, responsive-web, touch-editing or reconnect test was performed.
Cross-tool import/export fidelity and chat-download round-trip restoration were not established. The gallery says Voxta-format PNG; the editor claims character-card-v2 import.
Full sampler coverage and provider-specific advanced-setting parity were not verified.

reusablePatterns.pattern: Distinct new-story and exact-history actions with a visible premise and scenario.
Compact recalled-memory and summary explanation with correction links to existing owners.
Reach prompt diagnostics from the active story.
reusablePatterns.benefitInference: Investigate a surprising reply without losing story context.

reusablePatterns.pattern: Show effective service configuration and the source of each override.

doNotCopy.pattern: Correction controls discoverable only in a different view.
doNotCopy.reason: Users need a visible route to editing and retry.
Automatic participant interpretation needs clear consent and correction. This is a proposal, not a claim Voxta lacks either.

doNotCopy.pattern: The complete scenario scripting system without a separate authoring need.
doNotCopy.reason: It would expand scope and maintenance beyond ordinary chat.

characterOnboarding.note: Search/tag gallery, readmes, scenario choice, manual/AI-assisted/VRoid creation and card/package import.

storyOrganization.note: Search/filter/sort exact chats, summaries, rename/favorite/resume and creator Explore. An open chat cannot resume on another window/device until closed.

editRetryBranch.note: Edit, delete and regenerate in Chat view. Branch/checkpoint and alternate-reply preservation remain unknown, not absent.

memoryLore.note: Keyword lore, pinning/weights, lexical or embedding-assisted recall, experimental automatic memories/understanding; JSON/YAML/.voxpak export and Agnaistic lore-book JSON import.

promptTransparency.note: Inspector plus resolved prompt, raw result, tools, parameters and downloadable diagnostic report.

modelConnections.note: Saved per-function modules/presets; optional separate summarization model.

advancedControls.note: System-prompt strategy, post-history instructions, context and reply caps documented. Full sampler coverage unknown.

groupRoleplay.note: Scenario-assigned characters speak in turns; scenario or script controls the next speaker.

imagesVoice.note: Voice, transcription and image-generation modules; character voice selection and image prompt overrides. Quality untested.

mobile.note: Subscriber Android APK, Android 8+ and 13+ for on-device speech recognition; standalone or PC connection. Official site says no iOS app. No device or responsive-web test.

portability.note: PNG cards, .voxpak assets, memory-book exports and chat downloads. Cross-tool fidelity and chat round-trip unknown; device-key migration caveats apply.

selfHosting.note: Installed Windows runtime and Linux x64/arm64 server with web UI; full editions require a subscription. Proprietary software; no deployment performed.
